goal: Provide a page272-origin-only server hardening path for the Form33 service/topic choice only if fresh exact configuration and a safe non-delivery behavior proof show native Required is absent or insufficient, without mutating shared Form33 or creating a second validator owner.

current_semantic_chain.rule: Semantic v005 must be handled as its own conditional package first. Do not combine an unproven required-radio fallback into the first v005 deployment.

native_first_decision_tree.condition: mf_input_required == yes AND a provably no-network/no-entry validation check rejects an empty service group
native_first_decision_tree.action: No server fallback. Close D05 required-choice item and preserve shared Form33.

native_first_decision_tree.condition: mf_input_required != yes OR required configuration is absent
native_first_decision_tree.action: Do not edit shared Form33 from page272 scope. Read exact current ID5/ID36/field ownership and only then design a page272-origin server fallback.

native_first_decision_tree.condition: mf_input_required == yes BUT a safe non-delivery/no-entry validation check reproduces acceptance of an empty group
native_first_decision_tree.action: Evaluate the page272-origin ID36 server fallback below after exact ID5/field/error-copy reads.

native_first_decision_tree.condition: No safe no-network/no-entry behavior trigger exists
native_first_decision_tree.action: Do not improvise a real submission. Leave behavior proof open; do not generate or deploy fallback code solely from uncertainty.

mandatory_live_reads_before_any_fallback: exact current ID36 body/name/scope/active/code_error after any semantic-v005 deployment/readback state is known
exact #af-form-service widget ID/type/mf_input_name/mf_input_required and six labels/values/order
exact current ID5 body/hook priority/registration style/route guard/active/code_error
current visible/native required error copy and ownership if any fallback will emit user-visible text
confirm no newer validator owner already handles the same field/page origin

future_combined_candidate.name: semantic v006 + server required fallback
future_combined_candidate.base: the exact verified live/postread semantic v005 body, not a remembered reconstruction
future_combined_candidate.scope: keep front-end scope unless fresh Code Snippets/REST execution evidence proves that is no longer valid; never broaden scope casually
future_combined_candidate.server_callback: one named mf_after_validation_check callback generated only after exact field/route/error-copy reads
future_combined_candidate.semantic_preservation: preserve v005 page272 footer semantic code byte-for-byte except version marker/comment changes required by the new candidate

future_filter_contract: If incoming validation is already false, return the complete prior result unchanged so ID5/photo and native errors are preserved.
Return unchanged for every route that is not the exact current Form33 insert route.
Return unchanged unless referer resolves exactly to post/page 272 using the same proven MetForm origin mechanism.
Inspect only the exact live-read service field name; never infer from visible label text.
Treat missing/empty service choice as invalid only after native behavior failure/absence is proven.
Use exact proven user-visible error copy; never invent one.
Present service choice returns unchanged; do not whitelist or rewrite values unless exact six live option values/order are read and such validation is specifically required.
Never mutate shared Form33, ID5, ID6, entries, notifications or SMTP.
write_and_readback_contract_if_eventuall: one plugin-aware update of existing ID36 only
HTTP 429/unknown is UNKNOWN until exact ID36 readback; no blind retry
prove callback result with direct/non-delivery callback-level tests or another no-entry path; do not create a real Form33 entry
forbidden: generating fallback code before exact field/ID5/error-copy reads
using a real form submission merely to prove required behavior
changing shared Form33 required setting from the page272 package
creating a new global validator snippet
changing ID36 to global scope just to make a guessed REST path work
inventing field names, option values or error text
mixing review/content/SEO/CSS/outer-region fixes into the fallback package
